title: Chapter 2 · Inside the palace, zone by zone
description: La Reina Bubbaloo's palace in chapter 2 (docs/places/palace-zones.md): the pink hall's east door with the school's orange frame, el patio (court green, its lines risen into kerbs), el gimnasio (mat blue, wall bars into the dark), la secretaría (manila and steel, a queue that never moves, his desk under the only warm lamp) and el salón del trono (night indigo and gold, her throne in one spotlight), with their doors and gates.

steps.caption: The hall stays hers; at 35 its east door shows the school's orange frame
El patio: out of her hall onto the school's porch
El patio from above: the court's lines risen into a maze, the porch, the trough, the bags
The centre circle: the lost-property heap, where the zone's boss will stand
The east court: a hoop with its net stiff with gum, bags along the fence, the floodlight
The west side: the brick party wall, the push-tap trough with its pink water, plane trees
The porch: the Benvinguts mural painted over in pink but one word, the doors' orange frames and their signs
«La puerta no cede. Algo blando la sujeta por dentro.»
El gimnasio: blue mats stacked into a course, wall bars rising into the dark
El gimnasio from above: the circuit winds to El plint in the centre circle
El plint, grown into a stepped tower; where the zone's boss will stand
Ropes from a ceiling nobody can see; the ball cage, the changing rooms' door
«Es mi puerta. La llave entra… y no gira.»
La secretaría from the visitors' side: the queue that never moves faces the finestreta
La secretaría from above: the counter, the same desk in rows, the archive's aisles with manila boxes on top, his desk in the far corner
Behind the counter: the same desk, mug and pile again and again, a pink note on every screen
La mesa de Gerard under the only warm lamp, the key cabinet, Direcció's door
«Direcció. Cerrada por dentro.» «Por debajo sale luz. Como la de un escenario.»
El salón del trono: up her stair into the school's assembly hall at night
From above: empty folding chairs facing the stage, the ochre runner, her throne in the spotlight
Before the stage, where the final confrontation will be: her bubble swelling over a seat of chewed gum
Behind the throne the balcony opens on the night city: the view in the gallery's «Desde el balcón»
Direcció's door in the west wall, the school's orange frame: the last shortcut, back to the secretaría
